home.q: What does Waya do for founders?
a: Waya provides services, workshops, and AI-enabled products for mission-driven companies that are starting, growing, or pivoting. You stay focused on mission and product; we streamline operations, finance, people systems, and governance — from data room preparation and financial modeling to operations audits and the Scale Up Program.

home.q: What is unique about the process?
a: We're not management consultants who hand over a strategy deck and disappear. We're founders and operators who design, plan, and execute alongside you.

It starts with an intensive workshop that creates strategic focus and execution clarity. Then we embed with your team for 3–6 months, acting as fractional executives to bring the strategy to life through daily operating rhythms, SOPs, and culture work — connecting you with experts from our network for specific business or industry needs. Finally, we install our AI-enabled operating system, custom-built WayaFrames, to supercharge execution and decision-making at every level.

WayaFrames are AI-enabled frameworks that live inside your Claude Teams or Claude Cowork environment. Each one was designed by an industry and operations expert, encoding decades of hard-won knowledge into a structured, guided flow that integrates with your company's documents, data, and business applications. They work together as an operating system — the more you use them, the better they get at helping your business run as a single, coherent system.

home.q: What stage companies can you help?
a: We work with companies from the early stage through growth. Our Scale Up Program is a better fit for companies that have product-market fit and are at an important inflection point such as scaling or pivoting. Our Data Room, Financial Model, and Fundraising Narrative sessions are tailored to companies of all stages, from Seed through Series B+.

home.q: Do we have to be a US-based company to work with you?
a: No, our system works for companies in any region.

home.q: Does my company have to be a tech startup?
a: Waya works with technology companies as well as physical-world companies. You can be the founder of a tech startup, a non-profit organization, or a physical-world business. We are particularly effective for organizations with a high level of complexity, like supply chain, healthcare, and logistics.

home.q: When should I schedule a call?
a: When you've hit the ceiling of what you can solve alone. When you're the bottleneck and you know it. a: If you're planning to raise in the next 1–6 months — or if you just closed a round and want to maintain your data room so the next raise isn't another scramble — this is for you. We calibrate to your stage, from Seed through Series B+.

a: Data Room Preparation gets your full set of investor materials organized and complete. Financial Model Preparation goes deep on the piece investors scrutinize most — your model. The model we build drops straight into your data room.

Waya OS is an MCP server, a small service you connect to your AI assistant. It adds a set of WayaFrames: guided problem-solving frameworks the assistant runs with you. You describe a problem, and it helps you define it, find the root causes, and test a fix.

A WayaFrame is a framework that runs inside your AI assistant. The assistant walks you through a proven method, asking the right questions in the right order, and you finish with a real deliverable: a clear problem statement, a set of root causes, or a ranked list of experiments.

waya-os-mcp.q: How is this different from just asking Claude or ChatGPT?
a: Waya OS doesn't replace your AI assistant. It runs inside it. On its own, a general assistant answers whatever you ask, and it will suggest fixes before anyone knows the cause. Waya OS gives it a method: pin down the problem with numbers, find the root cause with evidence, then test a fix. Na'ama and Vince built that method scaling Cheetah to $150M in revenue and 350+ employees, and each session ends with a document you keep. It's the same assistant, following a method from people who have run a company.

waya-os-mcp.q: Do I need to learn commands?
a: No. Describe the problem in your own words, for example "help me figure out why our churn went up." Waya OS starts with A3 thinking and brings in gap analysis, experiment design, or impact vs effort when the problem calls for them. If you want one method on its own, ask for it by name.

pre-pmf-mcp.q: How is this different from just asking Claude or ChatGPT?
a: Waya doesn't replace your AI assistant. It runs inside it. A general assistant will talk through your idea for as long as you like, agree with most of it, and never tell you what to test first. The Wayaframes give it a set order: why you're the founder for this, what the business is, what it stands for, and which assumptions to test. Each one ends in a document you keep. Na'ama and Vince built them from scaling Cheetah to $150M in revenue, and in the workshop they coach you every week, which a chatbot can't do.

pre-pmf-mcp.q: What is the Product Market Fit Workshop?
a: It's a $3,000, 12-week workshop that stands up your PMF infrastructure. Each week pairs a group session on the Waya OS modules with a private hour with Na'ama or Vince — from your first hypothesis to a running system of experiments, automations, and analytics, so you leave with a working system for finding product-market fit, not just a plan.

Early-stage founders who are still searching for product-market fit — whether you're pre-idea, validating a hypothesis, or running your first experiments. If you know the destination is PMF but not yet the path, this is built for you.
